div.div: كُرَّجٌ A مُهْر [lit. a horse-colt, but app. meaning a mock colt, or hobby horse,] (K,) with which one plays: (TA:) [a thing] made (يُتَّخَذُ) like a horse-colt, upon which one plays: (Lth:) an arabicized word, from كُرَّهْ, (S, K,) which is the name of it in Persian. (S.) [Jereer, in two verses, mentions the جَلَاجِل, or little round bells, of a كرّج.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
